name: Gregory "1umberhack" Disney-Leugers
biography: Gregory Disney-Leugers (1umberhack) is a Independent Researcher specializing in adversary simulation, modern web authentication bypasses, and identity-based attacks. With over a decade of experience in red teaming and penetration testing since 2013, they have previously served as a Technical Lead at major technology and identity providers, including Juniper Networks and Okta.
